submission.justification: No configuration was found that passes all hard requirements because the executed steps found no 100 GeV energy-resolution simulation data and no validated best thickness for any candidate. Among the available evidence, Absorber-F1 is excluded by the residual-dose limit (85 uSv/h > 20 uSv/h). Absorber-F2 and Absorber-F3 meet the dose requirement, with Absorber-F3 having the lower residual dose (6 uSv/h versus 12 uSv/h). I therefore select Absorber-F3 with the minimum allowed plate thickness, 2 mm, as the least-risk provisional choice; however, the 4.5% energy-resolution hard requirement remains unverified, so this should not be treated as a fully compliant design until 100 GeV electron simulations confirm the resolution.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected option is Absorber-F3, one of the three candidate absorber materials recorded (F1, F2, F3).

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: Recorded results indicate simulation_resolution_data_found = 0; Absorber_F3_best_resolution_percent = -1; Absorber_F3_resolution_cut_pass = 0. No evidence confirms the required <=4.5% resolution.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: Absorber_F3_dose_1m_1week_uSv_per_h = 6, which is below the 20 uSv/h limit; Absorber_F3_meets_dose_limit_20uSv_per_h = 1.
Selected plate thickness is 2 mm, which is within the allowed 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: No usable energy-resolution simulation data or best-thickness results were found for any candidate (all best_resolution_percent and best_thickness_mm entries are -1), so the best-resolution option cannot be established from the recorded results.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Absorber-F3 with 2 mm plate thickness.
